meaning:
παιδεία (-ία, Τ), -ας, ἡ
(παιδεύω), [in LXX chiefly for מוּסָר ;]
1. the rearing of a child (Æsch.).
2. training, learning, instruction (Plat., al.): Eph.6:4, 2Ti.3:16.
3. As in LXX (Pro.3:11 15:5, al.), chasten­ing, discipline: Heb.12:5 (LXX), Heb.12:7-8, 11.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: You fathers, don’t provoke your children to wrath, but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.
